basis: Public project README documentation and original portfolio; project results have not been independently retested for this page.

arven.name: ARVEN
arven.current_scope: Active development. Individual integrations and performance are still being validated.

avelor.name: AVELOR ONE
avelor.current_scope: A design and engineering simulation. Physical hardware and measured bottle performance remain future work.

robot.name: Mobile Robot & Gripper
robot.current_scope: Autonomous navigation, AI recognition and mapping require matched source and reproducible demonstrations.

guideglass.name: GuideGlass AI
guideglass.current_scope: Research prototype. Physical distance sensing and assembled glasses need validation; not a navigation or medical safety device.

radar.name: Ultrasonic Radar System
radar.current_scope: Uses sound, not electromagnetic radar or LiDAR. The exact demo/source match and measurement accuracy still need confirmation.

verdant.name: VOLTRA Verdant
verdant.current_scope: Watering and solar features are owner-reported. Pump operation, charging, calibration and unattended reliability require physical tests.

voltra.name: VOLTRA
voltra.current_scope: An evolving ecosystem. Desktop-to-mobile and hardware integration are not presented as universally complete.

rover.name: VOLTRA ROVER AI
rover.current_scope: This illustration is a concept, not a verified rover demonstration.

core.name: VOLTRA CONTROL CORE
core.current_scope: The visual and browser study do not establish a connected physical controller.

atlas.name: VOLTRA Atlas
atlas.current_scope: The photographed screen is waiting for a fix. Satellite acquisition and positional accuracy are not established.

echo.name: VOLTRA Echo
echo.current_scope: The original photographed firmware and physical calibration remain unverified; no range or accuracy guarantee is claimed.

arcade.name: VOLTRA Arcade
arcade.current_scope: The new reference is not claimed as the photographed game. Actual joystick-to-display behaviour needs a recorded test.

thermal.name: VOLTRA Thermal Lab
thermal.current_scope: Cooling mechanism, circulation path and measured temperature performance remain unconfirmed.
